references.text: The continuation of the description of the cherubim on the mercy seat, their placement, and how their wings are to be spread out.
Bezalel carries out the work and makes the two golden cherubim for the mercy seat, just as it was commanded.
The first mention of cherubim in the Bible, as guardians at the entrance to Eden's garden.
God speaks to Moses from the mercy seat between the two cherubim.
The ark of the covenant with the cherubim is described as the place where the Lord of hosts reigns.
Solomon makes two large cherubim of olive wood for the Most Holy Place in the temple.
The ark of the covenant with the cherubim is placed in the Most Holy Place in Solomon's temple.
Ezekiel's vision of the cherubim at God's throne, showing the role of the cherubim in God's presence.
God reigns above the cherubim, a description of His glory and majesty.
The Lord is king and reigns upon the cherubim.
The letter to the Hebrews mentions the glorious cherubim who overshadow the mercy seat.
Fulfillment of the command: From instruction (chapter 25) to execution (chapter 37).
Concrete details about the unity between the cherubim and the atonement cover, emphasizing God's presence.
Thematic parallel: Transfer of the cherub motif from the tabernacle (Exodus) to the temple (2 Chronicles).
